terms.gloss: hollow, hollowed out, concave; as a noun (cavum, or cavus), a hollow, a hole
a pit, a hole; a hollow in the ground, especially one where water gathers

phrases.latin: ōlim rūsticus urbānum mūrem mūs paupere fertur accēpisse cavō
phrases.english: once upon a time, the story goes, a country mouse received a town mouse in his poor hole

phrases.latin: hōs cava contentō rētia fūne trahunt
phrases.english: these the hollow nets haul in on a taut rope

sources: Lewis & Short: cavus
